name: TOB Bible Theme
description: One Biblical theme (e.g. Faith, Grace, Covenant). Admin-authored content, browsed by every logged-in user via truth_of_bible.api.bible_themes (never raw REST for a normal user — same closed-permission-table pattern as TOB Bible Place).

fields.label: Weight
fields.description: Visual emphasis in the theme cloud — Large reads as more central.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Only Published themes are ever returned to the app.

fields.label: Relevant Passages
fields.description: One Bible reference per line (e.g. "Romans 5:1"), shown as tappable passages when this theme comes up in search.
